Bernstein called Phase 3 results a strong validation of Moderna’s individualized neoantigen platform, calling the data meaningful while keeping a Market Perform rating and $45 price target on MRNA.

MRNA fell below its 20-day moving average after leaked data, then rebounded. Traders note the drop came despite positive clinical results and amid valuation and future cash flow concerns.
Moderna (MRNA) faced an early leak of Phase 3 INTerpath-001 data before its ESMO presentation, drawing investor attention and mixed analyst reactions focused on the trial results.
